title: “Awesome” — electronic assent and quantity
summary: An electronic exchange concerning leads moves from an expected daily quantity to much higher quantities and an asserted absence of a limit.
notes: Does the response “awesome” assent to the proposed quantity or merely express approval? What exactly is the offer, and how does the surrounding conversation give the response meaning? The problem asks for interpretation of the exchange rather than a categorical rule about informal words or symbols.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 221–222. Open assigned page 221.
